html:
Plymouth, the capital and port of Montserrat, was abandoned in 1997 after flows from the Soufriere Hills volcano buried it under ash and mud. It is still the legal capital, the only ghost town in the world that is one.

Plymouth had been the island's only real town since colonial times, with the government offices, the market and the harbour. In the 1980s AIR Studios nearby drew stars such as Paul McCartney and the Police.

The government moved north to Brades, and a new town is being built at Little Bay. Plymouth lies inside the exclusion zone, with rooftops showing above grey ash, a few years after Hurricane Hugo had already damaged it.
